provenance.invariant: Committed evidence never stores the hash of the commit containing that evidence.
provenance.introducingCommitResolution: Derived at audit runtime with Git history; a new pre-commit migration is verified from the staged index; neither reference is persisted in this manifest.
provenance.headVerification: Each migration SHA-256 is compared with the same path at current HEAD, or its exact staged snapshot before the introducing commit, during audit check.
provenance.cleanTreeGate: deploy:preflight requires a clean working tree before running this audit.
